scope: P10 bounded YouTube name search and explicit result selection.
implemented: Authenticated voice members with Speak permission can search YouTube by a 1-100 character name without mutating the queue.
The provider command is bounded to five results, uses a fixed ytsearch prefix as one positional argument after --, disables plugins and restricts extraction to YouTube.
The active voice UI renders selectable results and queues only the chosen canonical video URL; /play with a name resolves the first result.
Search shares the resource limiter with play and surfaces provider-classified failures without exposing raw stderr.
remaining: Live YouTube lookup and two-client audible playback acceptance require yt-dlp, ffmpeg and LiveKit in the acceptance environment.
release: Source and automated fixtures only; no commit, push, merge, deployment or Windows update was performed.
